articles.summary: Munich, Germany November 11, 2026 Visteon Corporation and Shinry Technologies Co. LTD., through their joint venture Visteon-Shinry Power Electronics LLC (VSPE), are collaborating with Infineon Technologies AG (FSE: IFX / OTCQX: IFNNY), global market leader in automotive and power semiconductors, to develop a single-stage onboard charger (OBC) for electric vehicles.
